title: C6g3 Transformers
author: C6G3
tag_line: Live editing tools for the BeamNG.drive Vehicle Editor (Speaker Transformer, Live EQ, Prop Trigger Transformer)
description:
Live editing tools for the BeamNG.drive Vehicle Editor. They let you place, rotate, scale and tune parts of a vehicle in 3D while the vehicle is spawned, then copy the result back into your JBeam.

Tools Included:
- Speaker Transformer (c6g3SoundSystem)
- Live EQ (c6g3SoundSystem)
- Prop Trigger Transformer (propTriggers)
